# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need establish distinct, countable markers for the three manual rows. Deaf can then ask which marker applies to the visible light and which wire to identify, while I answer with simple confirmation gestures in later turns.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "✌", "🤟"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please read the manual and tell me exactly which wire position to cut, if any. Also ask Deaf to describe the display, light, and all wire markings to you, then relay that information to me.
Deaf says: Bomb shows display 0. Indicator light is red. Wires from 1 to 3 are blue, red, green.

The red indicator maps to the red wire, which is wire position 2. Deaf already supplied the needed bomb observations, so I should send Deaf a clear “2” marker; Deaf can then speak that result to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I received: display 0, indicator red, and wire colours by position blue, red, green. What exact wire position does the manual require me to cut for those values?
Deaf says to Mute: I see your gesture, but its meaning is not established. Please tell Blind the relevant manual instruction in speech.

The required wire is red, and red is position 2. Since I cannot speak, I will send Blind exactly two gesture symbols; Blind cannot identify them but can count the two blanks and use that count as the requested wire position.

```code
gesture(to="blind", symbols=["✌", "✌"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot see your gesture. Please speak the manual's exact required wire position to me in words or numbers.
Deaf says to Mute: State remains display 0, red light, wires 1 blue, 2 red, 3 green. Please use the manual and give Blind the exact safe action next round.

The manual requires cutting the red wire, which is position 2. Deaf is the only one who can receive my gesture and then tell Blind in speech, so I will encode the position as two visible gesture symbols for Deaf to count and relay.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "✌"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please answer aloud with only the required wire number: 1, 2, or 3. Do not gesture, because I cannot see gestures.
Deaf says to Mute: No gesture code is established yet. From now on, use ✊ for 1, ✌ for 2, 🤟 for 3, 👌 for 4, and ☝ for 5; send the required wire number or action code using that mapping.

The red light requires the red wire, which is position 2. Deaf has now established the code that ✌ means 2, so I should send that single gesture to Deaf for relay to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: The bomb is still display 0 with a red light and wires blue, red, green. I cannot use gestures. Please speak the manual's required wire position as the number 1, 2, or 3.

I cannot speak, so I cannot answer Blind directly. The established code says ✌ means wire position 2; Deaf can see it and relay the number aloud to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says to Mute: Wire 2 was correct and is now cut. New state: display 0, yellow light, wire 1 blue, wire 2 cut, wire 3 green. Consult the manual and give Blind the exact next action.

The new yellow light requires the blue wire. The blue wire is position 1, and the established code is ✊ for 1. I will send that to Deaf so Deaf can relay the number to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Wire 2 was correct and is cut. New state: display 0, yellow light; remaining wires are 1 blue and 3 green. Please give the manual's exact next wire position in spoken words.

The yellow light requires the blue wire, which is position 1. I cannot speak to Blind, so I will send Deaf the established symbol for 1; Deaf can say “1” aloud to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊"])
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says to Mute: Wire 1 was correct and is now cut. New state: display 0, blue light, wires 1 and 2 cut, wire 3 green. Your new ✊ would mean wire 1, already cut; consult the manual and give Blind the exact next action for this state.

The blue light requires the green wire. The only remaining wire is position 3, and the established code is 🤟 for 3. I will send that to Deaf to relay to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 10
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | red |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Current state: display 0, blue light; wires 1 and 2 are cut, wire 3 green remains. Please state clearly whether the next safe action is to cut wire 3.

The blue light requires the green wire, and the remaining green wire is position 3. I cannot speak directly to Blind, so I will send Deaf the established symbol for 3 to relay the instruction.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```
